chunks: Al-Hasan b. Muhammad b. Sa'id al-Hashimi al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: Furat b. Ibrahim b. Furat al-Kufi narrated to us. He said: 'Ali b. Muhammad b. al-Hasan al-Lu'lu'i narrated to us. He said: 'Ali b. Nuh al-Jina'i narrated to us. He said: My father narrated to me from Muhammad b. Marwan from Abu Dawud from Mu'adh b. Salim from Bishr b. Ibrahim al-Ansari from Khalifa b. Sulayman al-Juhni from Abu Salama b. 'Abd al-Rahman from Abu Hurayra. He said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) went out to battle. When he returned to Medina — and Ali (peace be upon him) had been put in charge of its people — he divided the spoils and gave two shares to Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon him). So the people said: 'O Messenger of Allah! You have given Ali b. Abi Talib two shares, even though he stayed behind in Medina!' So he said: 'O people! I plead you by Allah and by His Messenger: did you not see the horseman who charged the polytheists from the right side of the army and defeated them? He then returned to me and said: O Muhammad! Indeed, I have one share with you, and I have dedicated it to Ali b. Abi Talib. And that was Gabriel (peace be upon him). O people! I plead you by Allah and by His Messenger: did you see the horseman who charged the polytheists from the left side of the army and defeated them? He then returned, spoke to me and said: O Muhammad! Indeed, I have one share with you, and I have dedicated it to Ali b. Abi Talib (peace be upon him). And that was Michael.' So by Allah, I have only given Ali the share of Gabriel and Michael (peace be upon them both). Then all the people exclaimed Allahu Akbar.

key_terms.الْمَغْنَمَ: Al-Maghnam - War spoils/booty, the wealth captured during a military expedition
key_terms.جِبْرَئِيلُ: Jibra'il - The archangel Gabriel, chief angelic messenger in Islam
key_terms.سَهْمَيْنِ: Sahmain - Two shares; a sahm is a designated portion of war spoils
key_terms.غَزَا: Ghaza - To wage a military expedition or raid, a term used for the Prophet's campaigns
key_terms.فَكَبَّرَ: Fa-kabbara - They exclaimed Allahu Akbar (God is Greatest), expressing awe and affirmation
key_terms.مَعَاشِرَ النَّاسِ: Ma'ashir al-Nas - O people! A formal address formula used in public declarations
key_terms.مِيكَائِيلُ: Mika'il - The archangel Michael, associated with divine provision and mercy

ai.seo_question: What is the hadith about Gabriel and Michael giving their war shares to Ali in al-Amali of al-Saduq?
ai.summary: Abu Hurayra narrates that after a military expedition, the Prophet (s) distributed the spoils and gave two shares to Ali b. Abi Talib (as), even though Ali had stayed behind in Medina. When the people questioned this, the Prophet explained that two angelic horsemen — Gabriel on the right flank and Michael on the left — had each fought in the battle and then asked the Prophet to dedicate their respective shares to Ali. The Prophet thus affirmed that he only gave Ali the shares that the two archangels themselves had designated for him, at which the entire assembly proclaimed Allahu Akbar. This hadith, transmitted through a chain of twelve narrators, illustrates the special celestial honor bestowed upon Ali in early Islamic tradition.
